title: Complete comparator run
statement: Let $w,u,v$ be Boolean words and let $p$ be a valid input-head position for $w$. Starting the comparator in its scan phase with register true and both word-tape heads at zero, after exactly $2(\max(|u|,|v|)+1)$ steps it is in its return phase with register equal to the truth value of $u=v$ and both heads at zero; the other configuration data are as specified initially.
replaced:
For all words $u$ and $v$, whole-word comparison of $u$ and $v$ completes
silently in exactly $2(\max(\abs{u}, \abs{v}) + 1)$ steps, ending in the
return state with the register recording whether $u = v$, both word tapes
unchanged, and both heads back at zero.
